It's rare to find something that keeps your skin moisturized for so long, no matter what you try. Don't dismiss these pads as just another toner replacement ­ if you're not familiar with skincare, please refrain from commenting! While every step in skincare is crucial, if you don't nail the first step, the following ones won't absorb properly. I highly commend these pads for their ample essence and generous size. The perfect balance of texture and hydration helps soften the outermost layer of dead skin cells and opens pathways for deeper cellular hydration. In other words, the gentle pad and abundant essence pave the way for better absorption! The essence­rich formula gives a sensation of hydration building from within, and the moisture doesn't evaporate quickly, which I absolutely love. Best of all, there's no sticky residue. When my skin isn't at its best, these pads are perfect for masking due to their large size and plentiful essence. Makeup application afterwards is remarkably smooth. If you're considering purchasing pads, I wholeheartedly recommend this product! Despite having extremely dry and sensitive skin, these pads are incredibly gentle and the product is so mild that I haven't experienced any blemishes. Honestly, I can't find any downsides. As all women

avis.titre: You can subtly feel your skin...
avis.texte: You can subtly feel your skin becoming more firm and supple. I highly recommend Mediheal pads! I've tried all the different types, and each one is fantastic. Everyone, stop using other pads and switch to Mediheal pads! Unfortunately, the contents inside tend to leak out, which is a bit disappointing.

Works well as part of a daily mask routine. Storing in the refrigerator enhances its soothing effects.

The pad's mesh­like texture is great ­ it doesn't feel stuffy at all. It seems to smooth out skin texture nicely. The glow it gives is subtle but lovely. I've been using it religiously as the first step after my evening cleanse and before my morning makeup routine. The amount of essence is a bit scant. I noticed other users mentioning this too. It feels a bit too little... hmm, maybe I'm just being greedy? Try applying two or more pads to your face, leave them on for about a minute, then gently wipe off. I used to get frustrated with how hard it was to open some Mediheal masks before, but this line opens up so nicely and easily ­ it's a real pleasure to use! They recommend leaving it on to let the product absorb, but the pad seems too thick or something. It kept falling off, so I had to tilt my head back the whole time.

If you're new to retinoids or just want something super gentle, this is the one! The MEDIHEAL Retinol Collagen Lifting Pad is probably one of the most gentle options out there'so gentle, you can even use it during the day (just don't skip your sunscreen, okay?). The scent is super mild, so nothing overpowering. The cotton pads? Oh, they're soft but sturdy, so no awkward tearing or falling apart mid­use. You can even slap them on as a mini treatment mask if you're feeling extra. From personal experience, I saw a noticeable difference in my dark acne marks after a month of consistent use'nothing magical, but definitely faded. And the best part? New acne scars practically vanish within a week. These pads are seriously moisturizing, too, so you won't get that drying effect some retinol products have. Perfect for all skin types. Long story short, these pads are a win. You can't go wrong with Mediheal!

avis.titre: I love how it builds a...

avis.titre: I've been trying all types of...
avis.texte: I've been trying all types of Mediheal pads, and this time I used the collagen pads for the first time. I'm just sticking them on my cheeks and forehead, but they seem to have less hydration than expected and might fall off quickly. I'm thinking of keeping them by the sofa and sticking them on the back of my hands, neck, or cheeks when I'm bored. The only downside is that I use about 7 patches a day (which might be more than average), so having only 100 patches in a pack feels a bit limiting. For those with super sensitive skin or combination dehydrated skin, these patches work hard to provide that coveted Inner Glow without causing irritation or deep dryness.

avis.titre: I'm on my second box! When I...
avis.texte: I'm on my second box! When I apply 2­3 sheets as a toner mask for about 10 minutes, my skin feels hydrated and it seems to smooth out my smile lines a bit. While the thin sheets aren't ideal for use as an exfoliating toner, I still use them that way on busy mornings when I'm short on time! I love that it comes with 100 sheets, so I can use them generously. Sometimes I feel a tingling sensation when I have them on, but I'm not sure why it tingles.

Even though the pads aren't soaked in essence, they're still plenty hydrating. By stretching the pad, I could better apply it to the under­eye wrinkles. While I'll need to use it longer to fully assess the retinol effects, I've used it for a few days on my sensitive skin without any blemishes ­ it's been quite good! The pad size can be awkward depending on where you're applying it. Also, it doesn't stay put well ­ you can't do other things while wearing it. Try stretching the pad freely to customize its shape.

The pads are wonderfully wide ­ much larger than I expected! This made it so easy to apply to my forehead. There's plenty of product too. As the instructions suggest, you can use them like a lifting mask, which is great. The large size allows for a nice, taut application. I was skeptical at first since it's not a serum or cream, but I did notice my wrinkles becoming less noticeable. It was especially helpful for my nasolabial folds! Plus, my skin looks brighter after use. When I wake up the next morning, the difference in my complexion is striking. While it did help with wrinkles, I found the brightening effect even more impressive. As someone with thin skin who sweats easily, my skin tends to lose elasticity in summer. After trying this, I think it would be perfect for the warmer months! The brightening effect would be a real lifesaver during those skin­darkening summer days. While most aspects are positive, I noticed that the areas around my temples with existing blemishes actually worsened. Those with super sensitive skin might want to patch test first. If you're prone to occasional breakouts, you could try using it while avoiding those areas ­ that's what I did! The effects were good enough that I continued use, just skipping the trouble spots. Also, the lid is a bit flimsy, so make sure to seal it tightly when traveling! Follow the usage instructions for best results!

­ Scent: I'm quite sensitive to fragrances, but this one wasn't particularly bothersome! ­ Elasticity: I haven't used it for long, so I haven't seen significant results yet. However, I think it would be great for daily skincare if used consistently. I'll update my review if I notice more benefits after extended use. ­ Irritation: I felt a slight tingling sensation, which was the most disappointing aspect. ­ Adherence: The pads came off too quickly. I'll share some tips about this in the additional comments! ­ For better elasticity results, try stretching the pad while it's on your skin! ­ To improve pad adherence and make them more hydrating, store the container upside down. This allows the ampoule to saturate the pads more thoroughly, helping them stick better!

avis.titre: I was lucky enough to be...
avis.texte: I was lucky enough to be selected as one of The Hwahae Testers! Perfect timing, as I've been losing elasticity and experiencing dryness during this seasonal change. So, I gave the Mediheal Elasticity Pads a try! Patches that boost elasticity? That help with firmness? Intrigued, I applied them to areas I was concerned about ­ my nasolabial folds, around the eyes, and along the jawline, gently stretching the pads as I put them on. While they don't stick as firmly as tape, surprisingly, they did give a slight lifting sensation. As someone with super sensitive skin, I was pleased that the pads weren't irritating at all! I also appreciate the design ­ the tweezers don't touch the pads directly, and it's easy to insert and remove the refills. You'd need quite a few to cover your whole face, and it's in a bit of an odd position ­ not quite a sheet mask, not quite a toner pad. However, if you're curious, it might be worth trying once. I don't really have any pro tips to share, to be honest.

Usage Experience For a nourishing pad, it's pleasantly non­sticky. After removing the mask, my skin feels wonderfully hydrated. Sensitivity There was absolutely no irritation. Even with my super sensitive skin, I could use it without any issues. However, I only applied it to my neck for wrinkle improvement, so I can't speak to how it works on facial skin. Scent There's no artificial fragrance, which I appreciated. Effectiveness Given the nature of the product, I think consistent use is necessary to see results. I'll come back with a one­month review after using it a bit more. The product doesn't adhere well, so it can only be used while lying down. It lacks the stickiness to stay in place. I recommend using this while lying still, as it falls off easily if you move even slightly.

As someone with sensitive skin, I'm always cautious about potential allergic reactions when trying new cosmetics. Fortunately, I was able to use this product without any blemishes or allergic reactions. The application method is quite effective ­ by attaching one side first and gently pulling the opposite side as you apply, you can feel a lifting effect. With consistent use, I expect to see promising results. While it's not a clinical treatment, so immediate wrinkle improvement isn't noticeable, I believe regular use will definitely benefit the skin. I received this product as part of The Hwahae Testers program, and I'm considering repurchasing once I finish it. I think this product is well­suited for those looking for a daily anti­aging solution. There weren't any significant issues, but after using it for three consecutive days, I noticed slight signs of potential blemishes. I'd recommend using it every other day for best results. If you're having trouble separating the pads, try gently shaking them with tweezers. For application, start by attaching one side to the inner part of your face, then pull outwards as you attach the other side. This technique helps lift the skin as you apply. If the pads are still moist after treating your face, you can use them on your neck to address neck wrinkles as well.

avis.titre: As I've reached the age where...
avis.texte: As I've reached the age where I need to focus on firmness and retinol, I've become quite interested in products containing retinol and collagen. It's great to see retinol products, which usually require careful storage and handling, come in pad form ­ it's hygienic and convenient. I love that these pads feel light like toner pads, but still pack a punch without being sticky. The pads have an unusual texture, not as dense as gauze, which made me wonder if there'd be enough essence. Surprisingly, the material absorbs well, making them perfect for use as a mask ­ no shortage of hydration here! I really liked the slightly sticky texture and the wide, net­like patch that covers a large area even with just one application. It's great that tweezers are included for easy separation of individual patches. The high moisture content seems perfect for autumn when skin tends to feel dry. As someone in their late 40s with particularly noticeable laugh lines, I wonder if the product manager knew my concerns? Thanks to them, I won the Hwahae Testers event and got to try this product. The net­like structure allows for elastic stretching, and when applied, it gives a slight tightening sensation. Having super sensitive skin (recently developing contact dermatitis symptoms), I never dared to use retinol products. Fortunately, this didn't cause any blemishes. The tweezers for removing the pads!!! Please improve them! They're so stiff that they feel like they might break, and it's hard to grip the pads properly. As someone in their early 30s experiencing a noticeable loss in skin elasticity, I was eager to try this product and was fortunate enough to win it. While the texture appeared dry at first glance, upon application, it remained pleasantly moist for 10 minutes without drying out. I applied the pads to my cheek area and was impressed that they adhered perfectly without lifting, even as I worked on my computer. Although long­term effects remain to be seen, my skin didn't feel dry after use, even without applying additional emulsion. As others have mentioned, the sealing is extremely strong. I strongly recommend using scissors from the start. While the advertisements suggested a collagen pack­like effect that would lift the entire face, in reality, the pads are just slightly more elastic than usual. I have a feeling that storing these in the refrigerator and using them cool might enhance their firming effect and provide a refreshing sensation! Remember to use scissors to open the seal ­ don't strain yourself trying to open it by hand.

The plastic wrap is difficult to remove when first opening. The mask doesn't adhere very well to the skin. While it's moisturizing, it's not fully saturated with serum. I have combination dehydrated skin with large pores and redness. The texture and application experience: The mask had a thick gauze­like feel and wasn't rough, so there was no irritation. It stretched well, making it easy to apply over large areas. However, it wasn't thin enough to adhere closely to the skin. Effectiveness: It was great for refining skin texture. I loved how generously sized the pads were. Applying them for 10 minutes as the first step in my skincare routine left my skin feeling wonderfully hydrated. While some reviews mentioned the pads falling off easily, I didn't experience any significant issues. The amount of essence in each pad was just right. As someone with super sensitive skin, I was pleased that it absorbed well without causing any blemishes or adverse reactions. Opening the packaging for the first time was incredibly difficult. While the thick pads are nice, you need to carefully check if you're using one or two layers stuck together. It's good for basic hydration, but I'm concerned about the lack of instructions or precautions regarding retinol use. I know retinol is typically meant for nighttime application, but there's no mention of this. I've been using it during the day too, but I'm unsure if that's appropriate. These work great as a mask alternative ­ just stick them on your forehead and cheeks after cleansing. The generous quantity in the package is a definite plus.

The texture feels moisturizing and refreshing. As someone with super sensitive skin, I find it a huge plus that it doesn't cause any irritation. I don't think it has any noticeable lifting effects. It's best to think of it as a regular hydrating pad mask. It's a good idea to carefully adjust the direction when stretching and applying. Also, make sure to hold the tweezers close when using them!
